text:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health check for AcmeCorp onboarding — noticed a 2.4% uptick in overall error rate in the last 24h. Putting the top failing endpoints and a short breakdown here, please react with :eyes: if you can triage.

infra-bot: ALERT: spike_detected account=acmecorp metric=error_rate delta=+2.4% window=24h top_reason=5xx

kevin_eng: Pulling log rollups now, posting counts below. Short summary first: most failures are 5xx and timeouts from inference nodes in us-west-2.

kevin_eng: ```
summary (last 24h):
- total requests: 18,432
- total errors: 444 (2.41%)
breakdown:
- 5xx: 312 (70%)
- timeouts: 76 (17%)
- rate_limited (429/509): 56 (13%)

top failing endpoints (by error count):
1) POST /v1/generate                      — 182 errors — ~85% 5xx (OOM / 504s)
2) POST /v1/chat/stream                   — 96 errors  — ~60% timeouts (streaming stalls)
3) GET  /v1/embeddings                    — 48 errors  — ~90% 429s (burst throttling)
4) POST /v1/rerank                        — 34 errors  — mixed 5xx/timeouts
5) POST /v1/keyed/prefix                  — 12 errors  — 100% 504s (cache layer)

notes: errors concentrated on nodes rdx-enc-7/8 in us-west-2.
```

jake_se: Thanks — is this concentrated to a customer-specific route or global?

sam_ops: Can you confirm instance IDs + pods? I can drain the bad ones if needed.

kevin_eng: Instance list from logs: rdx-enc-7, rdx-enc-8, rdx-enc-14 (mostly 7/8). Pod traces show kernel OOM + long GC pauses on quantized kernels.

olivia_csm: FYI Acme PM mentioned they saw timeouts during onboarding walkthrough this morning — flagged earlier but we didn't have counts yet.

maria_cs: So proposed mitigations: 1) eng triage rdx-enc-7/8 and repro root cause, 2) ops drain/replace offending nodes, 3) add a temporary routing fallback (smaller model) for /v1/generate to reduce error surface, 4) CS to inform Acme with a brief status note. @kevin_eng @sam_ops please confirm ETA for steps 1–2.

nora_support: I can draft a short customer note (status + mitigation) once eng confirms safe fallback. Prefer to avoid technical detail — just impact + ETA.

jake_se: Quick mitigation I'm rolling out: set route `/v1/generate` retries=2 and fallback_model=gf-std-1 for canary on 10% of traffic — should cut errors ~40% while we fix nodes. Will post canary link.

kevin_eng: Acknowledged. Starting deeper debug now; will try repro with quantized checkpoint and reproduce OOM locally. ETA initial findings 3h.

sam_ops: I'll schedule node replacements and a rolling drain of rdx-enc-7/8 in the next 45m; will monitor error rate.

kevin_eng: Canary started by @jake_se, monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/alerts/2243156789 (shareable to oncall only).

maria_cs: Great — action items: 1) eng initial findings by +3h (kevin_eng), 2) ops node drain by +1h (sam_ops), 3) canary progress + alerts in this thread (jake_se), 4) CS draft + send customer note after eng ETA (nora_support). I'll follow up in next check-in. :pray:

olivia_csm: I'll add this to Acme onboarding tracker and note potential renewal watch if errors persist.

nora_support: Drafted message ready, will hold until kevin confirms ETA.

maria_cs: Thanks all — please ping if the error rate drops below 1.0% or any new hotspots appear.

infra-bot: NOTE: next automated check in 15m — will repost if spike continues.
